attributes.name: Druva - Administrator Deleted
attributes.description: Detects deletion of a Druva administrator account and records the deleted account, actor, result, and time.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects deletion of a Druva administrator account and records the deleted account, actor, result, and time.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.event_type == "Administrator Deleted"
| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp
| EVAL deleted_admin =
    TO_STRING(user.email)
| EVAL deleted_by =
    TO_STRING(user.id)
| EVAL result =
    TO_STRING(event.outcome)
| WHERE deleted_admin IS NOT NULL
